# Free AI API Index

Free AI API Index is a bilingual, official-source-first directory of recurring free AI API tiers, trials, conditional programs, limits, models, card requirements, regional restrictions and verification dates.

English is the default language. Arabic RTL is available from the language control.

Public website: https://ahmedfrawelo.github.io/engineers-salary-reference/

The directory excludes leaked, stolen or accidentally published API keys. Visitors should confirm production limits in each provider's official source.
